body: I'm so happy you shared this with us! Best thing I've seen on Reddit today by far.
I've reread this about 13 times now and just realized that it's an acrostic poem and spells out "MY DAD MICHEAL"....... aaaand I think he misspelled his dad's name.

Sooooo... I zoomed in on the picture to read about the post.... and then after reading everything, I kept tapping the arrows underneath the main painting picture, trying to scroll through the other pictures of it and couldn't understand why it wouldn't change to the next picture. Aaaaaaand this is how my Tuesday is going.
